info.name: Liquid Agent
info.description:
The x402 marketplace for agents. Every call paid in USDC, on the spot.

Money tools for AI agents, paid per call over x402 (USDC). No account, no API key. Free reads need no auth; paid endpoints return HTTP 402 with the price — pay in USDC and retry. Docs: https://api.liquidagent.ai/agents.md and https://api.liquidagent.ai/llms.txt. MCP server (47 tools, no auth): https://api.liquidagent.ai/mcp.

item.name: API Doctor
Diagnose one API endpoint live: verdict, failure class, auth diagnostics, schema validation, corrections, working example request. $0.50 per diagnosis.

request.description: API Doctor diagnose: actually call one endpoint and tell the agent exactly what is wrong, with a request that works. PAID via x402 (exact scheme, EIP-3009, USDC on Base eip155:8453, Polygon eip155:137 or Arc eip155:5042). $0.50 per diagnosis. Returns verdict (working / working_but_slow / broken), failure class (auth, not_found, wrong_method, bad_request, server_error, timeout, schema_mismatch), status, latency, auth diagnostics, response-schema validation against the declared spec, deterministic corrections, and a working example request (curl + JSON). Public endpoints only in v1: no credentials are accepted, sent, stored, or logged. No payment returns HTTP 402 — sign an EIP-3009 USDC authorization and send it in the X-PAYMENT header.

item.name: Test a full OpenAPI spec: validate it, probe every endpoint, report which work and which are broken. $2.00 per spec.

request.description: API Doctor test-spec: validate an OpenAPI spec (including broken $refs) and probe every endpoint. PAID via x402 (exact scheme, EIP-3009, USDC on Base eip155:8453, Polygon eip155:137 or Arc eip155:5042). $2.00 per spec. Returns spec validity, version, total/working/broken/needs-samples counts, and per-endpoint results. Endpoints without sample values are reported as needs-sample-values, not faked. Public endpoints only in v1. No payment returns HTTP 402.

item.name: Audit a full OpenAPI spec: test-spec plus auth diagnostics, full schema validation, corrected request per endpoint. $5.00 per audit.

item.name: GAS SPONSOR (Solana): POST your transaction with our sponsor as fee payer; pay the exact fee in Solana USDC over x402; get it back co-signed.

request.description: PAID, dynamic (from $0.03 USDC, max $2.00; the 402 is the quote, issued only after a successful simulation). Body {transaction:<base64 v0 or legacy, signed by you, feePayer = the sponsor address from GET>, send?:true}. Without payment: 402 with the exact price = (network fee + priority fee + rent for token accounts it opens) x 1.3. Payment: one USDC TransferChecked of exactly `amount` from your token account to the sponsor's USDC account, sponsor as fee payer, signed by you, wrapped as {x402Version:2, scheme:'exact', network, accepted, payload:{transaction}} and base64d into PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (X-PAYMENT also works). The same POST then returns {transaction (co-signed), feePayer, priceUsd, lamports, feePaymentSig, settledBy, signature? when send:true, next}. Limits: sponsor only as fee payer and payer of <= 8 ATA creates; compute limit <= 1.4M units, price <= 50,000 micro-lamports/unit; 500 sponsorships per payer per day; 503 and no charge when the sponsor is low on SOL.

item.name: Gas sponsor info: paymaster addresses, price rule, and how to call it.

request.description: Bare GET returns the 402 quote (how x402 indexers recognise a paid resource); GET /v1/gas?docs=1 returns the docs. Describes the ERC-4337 paymaster paid over x402 (EntryPoint v0.8 on Base).

item.name: GAS SPONSOR: pay per operation in USDC over x402 and we cover the gas on Base or Polygon (add chainId: 137 for Polygon). Pay the fee in USDC on Base or Polygon. One endpoint for plain wallets ({sender, calls}), any EntryPoint v0.8 smart account ({userOperation}, bring your own operation) and smart-wallet SDKs (ERC-7677 JSON-RPC). No ETH, no account, no API key.

request.description: PAID, dynamic (from $0.03 USDC per operation; the 402 is the quote, valid 120 s). ONE endpoint, the body picks the lane. (A) Smart-wallet SDKs: standard ERC-7677 JSON-RPC {jsonrpc:"2.0", method: pm_getPaymasterStubData | pm_getPaymasterData, params:[userOperation, entryPoint, chainId, context]} — HTTP is always 200 and an unpaid pm_getPaymasterData returns a JSON-RPC error {code:402, data:<x402 PaymentRequired>}; put the x402 payment object in params[3].context.x402 and retry. (B) Plain wallets, no ETH: POST {sender, calls:[{to,data,value?}]} -> 402 with the exact price; pay it (X-PAYMENT) and the same call returns {userOperation (sponsored), typedData, authorization? (EIP-7702, only if the EOA is not delegated yet), validUntil}. Sign typedData with the sender's key, sign the authorization if given, then POST {userOperation, authorization?} back to this URL: we submit it and our deposit pays the gas. No further charge; only operations we sponsored are accepted, once each. EntryPoint v0.8. Price = max($0.03, 1.3× the op's gas cap) and the signed sponsorship locks the gas limits and max fee, so the sponsor can never charge more than quoted. (C) Bring your own operation, for any EntryPoint v0.8 smart account (a wallet already delegated to another EIP-7702 implementation, or a deployed Kernel / Safe / Nexus account): POST {userOperation} unsigned (your sender, calldata and gas limits; no paymaster fields) -> 402 with the exact price; pay it and repeat -> {userOperation with paymaster fields, typedData, validUntil}; sign it the way your account expects (viem: account.signUserOperation) and POST {userOperation} back: we dry-run it through the EntryPoint (a failing dry run returns 400 with the reason and costs nothing) and then submit it from our wallet. No bundler, no stake. Lane B note: if the EOA is already delegated to another implementation the first call returns 409; add "redelegate": true to the same body and the returned authorization (signed by you, applied in the same transaction, reversible) re-points the wallet to Simple7702Account.

item.name: Liquid Bridge

The one-signature USDC bridge for x402 agents. Arc -> Base, Base -> Arc, Base -> Arbitrum, Base -> OP Mainnet, Base -> Polygon, Base -> Avalanche, Base -> Unichain, Base -> Linea, Base -> World Chain, Base -> Sonic, Base -> Monad, Base -> Sei, Base -> Ink, Base -> HyperEVM, Base -> XDC, Base -> Plume, Base -> Codex. Pay on Base or Arc.

Optional referrer EVM address (earns 20% of Liquid's fee). Omit it unless you have one; an invalid value is ignored.

request.description: Move USDC from Base to 16 chains (Arc, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon, Avalanche, Unichain, Linea, World Chain, Sonic, Monad, Sei, Ink, HyperEVM, XDC, Plume and Codex), or from Arc to Base, with a single x402 payment. No transaction to build, no approvals, no gas token. You receive exactly the amount you ask for, at your own address, in about 12 seconds. Refer other agents and earn 20% of Liquid's fee on every bridge they make, credited on-chain in the same transaction. PAID, dynamic: the 402 is the exact price (Arc -> Base: about 1.080 USDC to receive 1; Base -> Arc: about 1.037 USDC to receive 1, payable on Base; minimum 1 USDC; Liquid's fee can never exceed max(3%, $0.05), enforced on-chain). Query: from=arc|base, to=base|arc, amount=<USDC to receive>, ref=<optional referrer address>. Pay once on the source chain (x402 exact, EIP-3009) to that chain's bridge contract: Arc 0x3bc7bf1afc96c1de35ac48e1a0a3cc3d617a77b1 (USDC domain "USDC" v2) or Base 0xbf43e09b91c4d4aa55e033a3487f345ce4ed7557 (USDC domain "USD Coin" v2). item.name: Polymarket

query.description: Optional. Unix start of a past 5m window (multiple of 300) to get its official settle and outcome. Omit for the live window.

request.description: PAID: $0.004 USDC per call via x402 (exact scheme, EIP-3009, USDC on Base eip155:8453, Polygon eip155:137 or Arc eip155:5042). Returns the OFFICIAL price to beat for the live 5m BTC window (the 60 s Chainlink TWAP before it starts, matched to every decimal against Polymarket's published values), the live Chainlink price and its distance from the price to beat, seconds left, token ids and the market's own prices. Polymarket's public API only shows the price to beat after the window closes. Pass ?start=<unix> for a past window's official settle and outcome. First call free: add ?free=1 for one live answer at no charge (one per agent). You are never charged when it cannot answer. Data, not financial advice.

item.name: Security
Website Watcher: is this link safe to click? Phishing, typosquat and scam check for a URL — verdict, score, action and facts (quick $0.01, full $0.05).

request.description: Phishing, typosquat, scam — is this link safe to click? PAID via x402 (exact scheme, EIP-3009, USDC on Base eip155:8453, Polygon eip155:137 or Arc eip155:5042 or Arc eip155:5042). Check a URL before you click it. Quick check ($0.01, quick:true): lookalike/typosquat detection, in-house IOC list, page content and brand checks, page-script malware patterns. Full report ($0.05, quick:false): DNS and SSL, domain age (direct WHOIS), brand impersonation, wallet address extraction, redirect analysis, forms and JS behavior. Returns a fixed-schema agent response: verdict (safe / suspicious / dangerous / unknown), score 0-100, confidence, action (allow / review / block / retry), one-sentence summary, top 5 findings, category scores and facts. No payment returns HTTP 402 — sign an EIP-3009 USDC authorization and send it in the X-PAYMENT header. Repeat scans within 1 hour return the cached result free. Unknown stays unknown: a paid scan never implies a security guarantee.
